'''Girodyne''' was a manufacturer of various power and propulsion systems and engines.

Their products were often used in vessels produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

Girodyne was in operation at least as early as [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]], as it provided the nuclear steam engines for the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]] operated by [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Girodyne is first identified in ''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]'' as the manufacturer of the sublight engines of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. These devices have been both previously and subsequently referred to as products of [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] by the ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' and Chapter 3 of the [http://www.starwars.com/episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html Episode IV Visual Guide] respectively. Chapter 4 of the Visual Guide returns to the Girodyne identification, which either reinforces this connection or indicates Chapter 3 was in error. This change has not yet been addressed by an authoritative source such as [[Leland Chee]] or [[Pablo Hidalgo]].

The fact that Girodyne was operating as early as 70 BBY is based on the fact that sandcrawlers were abandoned on Tatooine around that date, as established by ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' and ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''.
